[[File:Aranea boots detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Aranea boots''' are a pair of boots dropped by [[araxyte]]s. With no requirements to wear, they are currently the best-in-slot boots for [[one-defence pure]]s and [[zerker]]s, due to the tribrid stats they have, with a ranged attack bonus between that of [[mixed hide boots]] and [[Blessed dragonhide armour|blessed dragonhide boots]], a magic attack bonus equal to [[infinity boots]], and a melee strength bonus equal to [[dragon boots]].

The boots have a special web-negating mechanic that allows players to pass through [[webs]] in various locations without the need of a [[slash weapon]]. Additionally, the boots also negate certain special attacks once every 8 [[ticks]] (4.8 seconds) from arachnid bosses; when this occurs, a game message will state {{mes|Your Aranea boots let you avoid the spider-based attack.}} The exception to this is [[Araxxor]]'s venom cleave, which can be negated only once every 6 attacks, so every 12 seconds (20 ticks).

The following bosses can have their spider-based attacks negated:
* [[Sarachnis]]' sticky web attack
* [[Venenatis]] and [[Spindel]]'s draining webs (The first tick is the only part of this ability negated)
* [[Araxxor]]'s venom cleave during his enrage phase
* [[Araxxor]]'s '''ranged''' auto attack; the '''magic''' auto attack is '''not''' negated.
* [[Verzik Vitur]]'s snapping webs during phase 3

==Item sources==
{{Drop sources|Aranea boots}}
If players are on a [[Slayer task]] for spiders or araxytes, the drop rate of aranea boots is improved from 1/4,000 to 1/1,600 or 1/2,000 to 1/800 depending on the araxyte's combat level.

==Trivia==
* ''Aranea'' is Latin for spider or a spider's web.
* Aranea boots were originally going to be dropped by [[Araxxor]], but were later decided to be dropped by [[araxytes]] instead.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/araxxor?oldschool=1|title=Araxxor|newsdate=28 August 2024|quote=Note that these [boots] are now obtained as a drop from regular Araxytes and not from Araxxor. Our reasoning here was to prevent their value plummeting while they're just passively obtained by players chasing the rarer and more high-value uniques. So if you're looking to grab a pair for yourself, get those Slaughter bracelets ready and start splattering loads of little arachnids!}}
